stages.name: S1 认识键盘
stages.desc: 熟悉键位分区、打字姿势和指法分工，建立不看键盘的基础

sections.name: 指法分工入门
sections.desc: 左手小指到右手小指各管一片键位，先用基准键感受八个手指的分工
sections.text: asdf jkl; asdf jkl; asdf jkl; fdsa ;lkj fdsa ;lkj asdf jkl;

sections.name: 八个基准键
sections.keys: a s d f j k l ;
sections.desc: F 和 J 键上的小凸起是食指定位点，双手食指搭在上面，其余手指自然落位
sections.text: fff jjj fjj jff fjf jfj ddd kkk dkd kdk sss lll sls lsl aaa ;;;

stages.name: S2 基准键练习
stages.desc: 把基准键练到盲打水平，这是之后所有练习的地基

sections.name: 基准键组合
sections.desc: 两指组合击键，注意每击一键手指立即归位
sections.text: as df jk fl dj sk la; ja fj dk sl ;a sd jf kl ad ls aj f;

sections.name: 基准键单词
sections.desc: 用基准键组成的常用单词，练习连贯击键
sections.text: as all fall salad glass half flask dad lad ask sad adds glad

sections.name: 基准键句子
sections.desc: 加入空格和大小写，接近真实输入场景
sections.text: A lad ask dad if all fall salad glass flask half adds glad

stages.name: S3 上排键练习
stages.desc: 向上延伸一行，攻克 QWERT / YUIOP 键位

sections.name: 上排键位
sections.keys: q w e r t y u i o p
sections.desc: 从上排击键后，手指要立刻回到基准键
sections.text: qqq www eee rrr ttt yyy uuu iii ooo ppp qw er ty ui op pq

sections.name: 上排单词
sections.desc: 含上排字母的常用词，注意手指跨度
sections.text: quiet report tower power your type write order pour yet you true

sections.name: 上下行混合
sections.desc: 基准行与上排交替，巩固手指记忆
sections.text: The quiet power of a report tower was a great test for us all

stages.name: S4 下排键练习
stages.desc: 向下延伸一行，攻克 ZXCV / BNM 键位并认识 Shift

sections.name: 下排键位
sections.keys: z x c v b n m
sections.desc: 下排击键同样要归位，注意无名指和小指的协调
sections.text: zzz xxx ccc vvv bbb nnn mmm zx cv bn mn xz vc nb nm zzz

sections.name: 下排单词
sections.text: zinc cube van ban man move zone cave next verb comb mine

sections.name: 三行混合
sections.desc: 上中下三行混合，Shift 换挡开始登场
sections.text: A man can move a zinc cube into the cave and come back soon

stages.name: S5 数字与符号
stages.desc: 攻克数字行和符号键，这是提速的关键一跳

sections.name: 数字键位
sections.desc: 数字行离基准行最远，需要刻意练习手指跨度

sections.name: 符号键位
sections.desc: 符号大多需要 Shift 配合，注意左右手分工

sections.name: 数字符号混合
sections.text: Buy 2 pens at $1.50 each, that is 100% of a $3.00 order #42

stages.name: S6 综合文章
stages.desc: 用完整文章检验盲打成果，向实用速度冲刺

sections.name: 经典短句
sections.desc: 包含全部字母的经典句子
sections.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs.

sections.name: 常用句型
sections.desc: 切换自由模式，允许退格修正，追求流畅
sections.text: Practice makes perfect. Typing is a skill that grows a little every single day you show up.

sections.name: 短文练习
sections.desc: 较长文本，锻炼耐力与稳定性
sections.text: Learning to type without looking at the keyboard takes patience. Start slow, keep your wrists relaxed, and let your fingers learn the way home. Speed is a byproduct of accuracy, so do not chase it. With twenty minutes of daily practice, most people reach forty words per minute within a month and keep improving from there.
